title: Certificate of Accreditation
description: We have officially received our 𝘾𝙚𝙧𝙩𝙞𝙛𝙞𝙘𝙖𝙩𝙚 𝙤𝙛 𝘼𝙘𝙘𝙧𝙚𝙙𝙞𝙩𝙖𝙩𝙞𝙤𝙣 from the LSU Council of Student Organizations during 𝙆𝙪𝙡𝙩𝙪𝙧𝘼𝙣𝙞𝙢𝙤 2024! 🎉 This accreditation is a testament to our commitment to excellence and our dedication to fostering creativity and innovation in the field of ICT. We look forward to another year of serving the Lasallian community and beyond.

title: LSU joins Hack4Gov 2024
description: Congratulations to our fellow CS/IT students for ranking in the top 4 and 6 in DICT Region 10's Hack4Gov 2024! 🎉 Led by Mr. Earl Peter Gangoso, our CS Program Head, your hard work and dedication have truly paid off. We're so proud of your achievement. Keep shining in the tech world! 💚

title: Official Facebook Group Page
description: Come and join our group page and connect with fellow 𝗟𝗦𝗨 𝗖𝗦/𝗜𝗧 𝘀𝘁𝘂𝗱𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀, 𝗳𝗮𝗰𝘂𝗹𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀, 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗮𝗹𝘂𝗺𝗻𝗶! Share your thoughts, ask questions, and stay updated on everything IT related. Let's build a stronger community together! 🤝 https://bit.ly/lsucsitgroup
